command:
$ErrorActionPreference="Stop"
$src=Join-Path (Get-Location) "logs\high-contrast\high-contrast-shell.png"
$dst=Join-Path (Get-Location) "logs\remote-evidence\high-contrast-shell-failed-run-37252600680.png"
if(-not(Test-Path -LiteralPath $src -PathType Leaf)){throw "retained High Contrast shell screenshot missing"}
Copy-Item -LiteralPath $src -Destination $dst -Force
Write-Host ("HC_RETAINED_SCREENSHOT=" + $dst)
Write-Host "HIGH_CONTRAST_RETAINED_SCREENSHOT_COPY_PASS"
